items.name: Consolidate InstallmentStatus and PaymentStatus enums
items.description: Merged finance/InstallmentStatus and contract/PaymentStatus into a single contract/InstallmentStatus enum. Deleted both source files. Updated 6 consumer files (3 models, 3 components).
items.evidence: bunx eslint on all touched files — 0 errors. bunx vue-tsc --noEmit — clean. bunx vitest run — 18 files, 238 tests passed. grep confirms zero remaining references to PaymentStatusEnum or finance/InstallmentStatus.
